name: zu-de-clemens
description: Suggests a diagram when one would help, and draws it in a side pane with D2 when you ask.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: API key for Jev (TypeSafe). Get one from the TypeSafe console.

threshold.title: Suggestion threshold
threshold.description: Jev probability (0-1) at or above which a diagram is suggested.

auto_mode.title: Auto mode (not recommended)
auto_mode.description: Draw diagrams without asking. Uses Claude every time Jev is above the threshold.

image_check.title: Diagram check (experimental)
image_check.description: Show each drawn diagram to Jev as an image and redraw it when it fails the check.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane: auto, ja or en. auto follows the conversation.
